mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 61 degrees with overcast skies by Badger Ridge Middle School. It is currently a first quarter moon phase, and space fans should keep an eye on the sky at 4:55 AM as the International Space Station passes from Mount Horeb toward the Fitchburg area.

City crews are busy with the Mark Drive reconstruction project between Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue. This extensive work includes replacing sewer and water utilities, followed by new pavement and sidewalks. The city is also continuing its commitment to a complete active transportation network by prioritizing new sidewalk installations to help residents walk more safely across our community.

Today is packed with activities including the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, look forward to the free Concerts in the Park series at Century School Park and trivia night at Hop Haus Brewing.

In police news, officers responded to a noteworthy call last Friday when a driver was found intoxicated behind the wheel. The operator was arrested for an O W I and cited for multiple traffic violations.
Double Strawberry is our flavor of the day today. Culver's is currently closed, but they will open their doors at 10 AM so you can grab a scoop.
